task.title: Creating an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction for IPOC

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the Integrity registration number.
Detection: This field is prefilled according to the type of investigation in NIIS.
Message: Select 27 - An overpayment resulted due to an incorrect calculation .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the Integrity registration number.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 54 - Third party fraud .
Remarks line 1: Type “Cancel fraudulent renewal. Unknown third party.”

Remarks lines 2–4: Type the appropriate information:
For all payments and cycling reports to be removed, type “Remove w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX]. Total amount $[XXXX]. Adjust tax file or T4E. No OP for client.” If payments have been returned or cheques were never cashed, type “Also cancel returned payments or uncashed cheques, as appropriate, for w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX].” For each payment, type “w/c [XXXX] / [T071-2 for current year or T071-8 for the previous year] / reason F / CT [XX] / gross benefits [XXXX] / federal tax [XX] / provincial tax [XX] (if necessary) / net amount [XXXX] / PRN [XXXXXXXXXXXX].”
If an OP must be established because the client received payments for which they are not entitled, type “Establish OP to the client for w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX]. Client not entitled to benefits received.” Add the appropriate paycoding (disentitlement, earnings, not available days, FWW, etc.).
If an MA was imposed to stop payments, type “Rescind MA[XX].”
If the claim must be renewed, type “Renew claim w/c [XXXX], CT [XX].”
If payments must be issued to the client , type “ Issue payments from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX].” If paycoding is required, type “[appropriate paycoding, e.g. FWW, non-available days, sick days].” If there is an allocation, type “M175 [type] [amount] from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX], [amount, if different from last week] (add more w/cs if necessary).” If a disentitlement must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].” If a disqualification must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX].”
If the client has a continuing claim, type “Issue paper claimant’s reports to client.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
